config_name: iPad Pro 11-inch — M5 (10-core CPU/10-core GPU), 16GB RAM, 2TB SSD, 11" Ultra Retina XDR tandem OLED + Magic Keyboard

specs.keyboard_notes: Magic Keyboard included in price: scissor keys (unlit), glass trackpad, cantilever hinge
specs.pen_support: Apple Pencil Pro +$168.99 (BBY sale; ~$199 Apple) — not included in total. Nano-texture glass option +$150.

battery.notes: Apple claims 10h web/video on Wi-Fi. Users report ~8-9h mixed real-world use; 11" cell slightly smaller.

price.notes: Tablet-only $3,229 apple.com/ca (IPAD_LIST.md, verified 2026-11-24; BBY stocks 256/512 tiers) + Magic Keyboard 11" $399.99 (BBY 17932865). Nano-texture +$150 optional. Apple Pencil Pro $168.99 not included.

reviews.quote: An extremely fast M5 SoC and Wi-Fi 7. Pros: extremely fast M5 SoC, sturdy and timeless case, Wi-Fi 7 and 5G, good camera quality for a tablet, powerful speaker sound, comprehensive software package, good battery life, bright and accurate display. Cons: no power adapter included, very expensive, PWM flickering, no always-on display, only a 12-month warranty. (NBC review of the iPad Pro 11" M5 2025, 90% very good; same SoC and panel family across 11"/13" tiers.)

praises: 2TB means the whole working library travels — multi-terabyte ProRes shoots and full Lightroom catalogs live on-device permanently
16GB RAM unlocks LumaFusion multitrack 4K, huge PS/Affinity files, and on-device AI models without memory ceilings
All that capacity in a 444g, 11" chassis is unmatched — a mobile studio that fits a jacket pocket
Tandem OLED with 1000-nit SDR and 120Hz ProMotion is superb for its class
Thunderbolt + huge internal scratch disk makes external-drive-free field workflows viable
complaints: $3,629 with keyboard — laptop territory while iPadOS still blocks desktop-class apps; the value curve breaks here
Apple's +$700 for 2TB over 1TB is many times the market price of the flash
16GB RAM is gated behind the 1TB tier; storage is the toll, not the point
Magic Keyboard $399.99 still has unlit keys at this price
11" screen is cramped for the very pro multitasking workflows this tier targets

design_philosophy: The maximum-capacity iPad Pro ever: 2TB of soldered NVMe and 16GB unified memory in the compact 11" chassis, aimed at field shooters and editors who keep entire productions on-device. Every performance factor is identical to the 1TB tier — this entry buys pure storage headroom, at Apple's steepest per-gigabyte pricing. With the Magic Keyboard priced in it exceeds most real laptops, which is the line this config tests most sharply.
rating_notes: Pro score attached from NBC review of the iPad Pro M5 13" (90%, gap-fill 2026-11-24). Ratings inferred from the 13" M5 256GB anchor (see SHARED-ipad-pro.md); no verbatim pro score found this session (bot-walled) — disclosed, none invented. 11" deltas plus 16GB/10-core (productivity +0.5, ai_ml +0.5); 2TB storage: creative_work 9.4 (max on-device library headroom) — storage changes no other performance factor. Ecosystem 6.5 (~9 casual/creative, ~5-6 desktop-app parity). Keyboard_trackpad rated on the Magic Keyboard (included). Upgradability 1.0: everything soldered.
